environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell. Do NOT touch tracking (src/components/TrackMap.tsx, app/track/*) or the rider flow (app/rider.tsx, /orders/accept, /tracking/*). contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md in this subtree. README.md documents build/signing only. Follow the existing code conventions: AsyncStorage via '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage', versioned storage keys, try/catch around all storage/network, zustand stores in src/store, React Query hooks in src/queries.ts, UI primitives from src/components/ui.tsx.
key_patterns: Offline cache pattern lives in src/persistCache.ts (versioned AsyncStorage key, try/catch, debounced persist, MAX_AGE). The api helper (src/api.ts) uses a {success,message} envelope, Bearer access token in memory, refresh token in SecureStore, single silent refresh on 401 guarded by opts._retried and a single-flight `refreshing` promise; refreshSession() clears the refresh token only on 401/404. Toasts/confirm via src/store/ui.ts (showToast, showConfirm). Shimmer skeleton + Loading in src/components/ui.tsx. Address create payload today uses `id: selectedId ?? undefined`; temp optimistic ids must be NEGATIVE (-Date.now()).
